name: livepatch
description: Block-and-wire audio patching environment: Windows audio / ASIO / VST pipelines with a fully customizable node editor.
author: LivePatch
//repository: Single source of truth for the update feed: electron-builder derives the GitHub owner/repo for both `--publish` and the app's baked-in app-update.yml from this field. Set it before the first release.

scripts.package: npm run build:vsthost && npm run build && npm run bundle:node && electron-builder --win
scripts.package:dir: npm run build:vsthost && npm run build && npm run bundle:node && electron-builder --win --dir
scripts.release: npm run build:vsthost && npm run build && npm run bundle:node && electron-builder --win --publish always
scripts.android:app: npm run build && node scripts/build-android.mjs app

//overrides: Security pins for TRANSITIVE dependencies whose parents still range-pin a vulnerable version. Every entry here is dev/build tooling (Capacitor's CLI + asset generator, cmake-js under audify) — none of it ships inside the app. Re-check with `npm audit` after any dependency bump and delete an entry once the parent's own range has moved past it; a stale override silently holds a package back.
